description: 水庫基本資料 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 台灣早年即有水庫之建設，水庫管理更是本署的重要工作項目之一，本署每年針對公告水庫的基本資料進行維護，由水庫之管理單位依營管需要測量後並更新產製，內容包括年度、地區別、水庫名稱、水庫代碼、河川名稱、機關名稱、機關代碼、鄉鎮市區名稱、型式、壩堰高、壩堰長、集水區面積、滿水位面積、設計總容量、設計有效容量、目前總容量、目前有效容量、最近完成庫容... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
